content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Infrastructure sovereignty for digital commerce means creating a self-owned, self-sustaining payment infrastructure that is not reliant on third-party platforms like Teachable or Stripe. This approach ensures that creators maintain control over their payment processing, data, and products, making them less vulnerable to platform restrictions, suspensions, and account closures. By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can sell their products without being locked into a specific platform or relying on a limited set of payment gateways.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack is built using a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This architecture allows creators to build a scalable, secure, and flexible payment infrastructure that can handle a high volume of transactions without relying on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for creators in countries where platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy are unavailable or severely restricted. By providing a sovereign digital commerce stack, COREMERCH empowers creators to take control of their payment infrastructure, ensuring they can sell their digital products without being locked into a specific platform or relying on limited payment gateways. This approach also gives creators the flexibility to scale their business and adapt to changing market conditions.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is the most secure way to process payments online.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes Stack 02, deployed in 48 hours, with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is designed to handle a high volume of transactions, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. The 30-day support ensures that creators have a reliable resource for any questions or issues they may encounter.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps: visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, select the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), and purchase the solution. Once deployed, load your products, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and test the system to ensure it is working as expected. With this approach, creators can take control of their payment infrastructure and start selling their digital products with confidence.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
